note: HAND-CURATED. The only place in this product a displayed date may originate. One entry per human-confirmed date or published annual rule; nothing enters without a quote from the record or the report, and no entry may be derived from a field containing PRIOR CYCLE. Validated by scripts/build-calendar.mjs — every quote below is checked verbatim against its cited source, every programmeKey against programmes.json, every fundingId against funding.json.

confidence.confirmed: A human read the source and it names a date for THIS cycle (the September 2027 intake, or the 2026/27 application year that feeds it).
confidence.recurring-pattern: The source publishes an annual rule, or the researcher projected the next cycle from a stable pattern. It is a date-shaped expectation, not a published 2027 date. It must never be rendered in the same channel as a confirmed date.

entries.label: Swiss ESKAS arts scholarship opens
entries.quote: 20 August 2026 — WITHIN DAYS OF NOW.
entries.note: CHF 2,450/month, the highest monthly stipend in the corpus. Country deadlines follow between September and December 2026 and are published from August 2026. Tunisia's presence on the 2027-28 ARTS country list is UNKNOWN — one email to sgs@sbfi.admin.ch settles it.

entries.label: ARES / Wallonia-Brussels masters bursary — 2027-28 call expected
entries.quote: circa August 2026 via the GIRAF platform
entries.note: Tunisia is an explicitly listed partner country and the bursary waives the €4,175 Wallonian supplement. The window is a projection from the previous call, which is recorded only in a PRIOR CYCLE string and therefore contributes no date here. Check the ARES catalogue: the blocker is subject scope, not eligibility.

entries.label: DAAD Study Scholarship — deadline reported for 2027 funding
entries.quote: the deadline is reported as 31 August 2026 — i.e. ALREADY IMMINENT. VERIFY on the DAAD portal immediately; deadlines vary by country and are updated annually.
entries.note: Reported, not read off the portal. Country-specific. A music-technology or media-informatics master at a regular university fits this scheme; a Musikhochschule master would be pushed to the artistic scheme, which he cannot use.

entries.label: Campus France Tunisie 'Études en France' opens
entries.quote: Campus France Tunisie 1 October 2026.
entries.note: The single gate in front of every French option — a Tunisian resident does not use Mon Master. The same date is stated independently on records 19, 20, 23, 25, 26, 27, 28, 126, 280, 281, 282, 283 and 284.

entries.label: HAW Hamburg — aptitude-test registration with work samples
entries.quote: CONFIRMED CURRENT: the DAAD database publishes the window as '01.10.2026 – 31.10.2026' for the aptitude test
entries.note: Step 1 of two; the formal study-place application runs 1 December – 15 January. Entry is SUMMER SEMESTER ONLY, starting early April — this is the April 2027 intake, not September 2027. One secondary source says 'until 14 October'; resolve that with the faculty before relying on the end of the month.

entries.label: Politecnico di Milano — first non-EU call
entries.quote: He should treat the 1 October to 1 December 2026 first call as his primary deadline.
entries.note: The deadline field itself is a PRIOR CYCLE string and yields nothing; this window is the verifier's reading of the call pattern. No portfolio, no interview, no audition, English-taught — the one target that fits on every axis.

entries.label: Tunisian bourse d'études à l'étranger — circulaire expected
entries.quote: Approximately October, with the annual 'Circulaire' and country annexes
entries.note: His own government, no nationality bar, the most complete package found: tuition + €800/month + social security + health insurance + travel. Two unknowns decide it — whether arts and music are eligible fields, and whether an admission letter is required at application. The month is a pattern, not a published date.

entries.label: KTH — application opens for autumn 2027
entries.quote: 16 October 2026 (for autumn 2027 start) — as stated on the KTH programme page
entries.note: The deadline half of this record is a PRIOR CYCLE string, so only the opening is a date here. Swedish admission closes in mid-January; treat 15 January 2027 as a question to settle, not a date.

entries.label: ETH Zürich Excellence Scholarship (ESOP)
entries.quote: CONFIRMED CURRENT: 1–30 November 2026 (23:59 MEZ) for a September 2027 (HS27) start.
entries.note: Only relevant on a technical route — a music-computing MSc rather than a conservatoire master. His software-engineering BSc is exactly the profile ETH funds.

entries.label: University of Lausanne master's grant closes
entries.quote: CONFIRMED: 1 November 2026 for a September 2027 start (2027/2028 intake).
entries.note: CHF 1,600/month plus fee exemption. UNIL has no music or sound master's, so this is only live if he broadens to media or cinema studies.

entries.label: Royal Danish Academy of Music — Tonmeister closes
entries.quote: omits the live 2027 deadline: 1 December 2026 for the autumn 2027 intake, which is the single most time-critical date found in this slice
entries.note: The deadline field carries a PRIOR CYCLE marker and yields nothing; the correction names the live date. BLOCKED on a prerequisite degree — entry is restricted to holders of a 'Bachelor of Music as tonemeister'. Ask about equivalence, or rule it out; do not build a portfolio for it first.

entries.label: Groningen — admission deadline to be nominated for the Eric Bleumink Fellowship
entries.quote: He must apply for ADMISSION BY 1 DECEMBER 2026 to be considered for the Eric Bleumink Fellowship nomination for the September 2027 intake
entries.note: Nomination only — five months before the ordinary non-EU admission deadline of 1 May 2027. Tunisia is on the eligible list. RUG has no electronic-music production degree, so the fit is moderate at best.

entries.note: An annual rule, not a published 2027 date. No closing date is recorded anywhere in the record.

entries.label: FHNW Basel — MA Producing (Schwerpunkt Realisation)
entries.quote: NOT a prior cycle — the page already advertises the start date 13.9.2027, so for the September 2027 intake the window is 15 December 2026 – 15 February 2027, live round in April 2027, results by e-mail in May 2027.
entries.note: The strongest single target in the corpus. The app's parser badges this record 'PRIOR CYCLE — confirm the 2027 date' because the first date in the string is 15 December 2026; the string it is reading says, in so many words, NOT a prior cycle. CHF 2,500/yr for a Tunisian, one self-produced mix plus a method PDF, no German.

entries.label: FHNW Basel — MA Komposition/Musiktheorie, Audiodesign (Elektronisches Studio)
entries.quote: NOT a prior cycle — the page already lists the start date 13.9.2027, so for September 2027 the window is 15 December 2026 – 1 March 2027, with the German B1 certificate due by 31 May 2027.
entries.note: The second Basel door, two weeks longer than the Producing window — but it needs German B1 by 31 May 2027, which the Producing route does not.

entries.label: Masaryk Brno — Zvukový design opens
entries.quote: 1 January
entries.note: Free to every nationality when taught in Czech, and open to any bachelor's. The closing date exists only inside a PRIOR CYCLE string on the same record, so it is a question here, not a date.

entries.quote: VERIFIED. Applications for admission to academic courses, complete with pre-selection links, are accepted each year from 1 JANUARY and no later than 30 APRIL.
entries.note: A standing annual window, verified on the school's own page — but the 2027 edition is not separately published. Portfolio only, no audition.

entries.label: Türkiye Bursları — Arts Scholarship (Sanat Bursu)
entries.quote: Arts Scholarship Programme applications are received "between 10 January and 20 February" each year. For a Sept-2027 start: circa 10 January – 20 February 2027. EXACT 2027 DATES UNVERIFIED until YTB publishes the calendar.
entries.note: Fully funded, under-30, explicitly an arts track that accepts a non-music bachelor's, and it places candidates into İTÜ MIAM. YTB has not published the 2027 calendar, so this is the published annual rule and nothing more.

entries.label: Campus France Tunisie — master applications close (~15 January)
entries.quote: he must go through Campus France Tunisie 'Etudes en France': opens 1 October 2026, master applications close ~15 January 2027.
entries.note: The record writes it with a tilde and so does results/DOOR3.md — 'Campus France Tunisie closes ~15 January 2027'. Approximate, and it closes 28 French options at once, which makes it the most expensive approximation in the file. One call to the Institut français settles it.

entries.label: SKH Stockholm — Film Sound Design closes
entries.quote: 15 January 2027, for a START IN AUTUMN 2027. This is a genuinely current, published date and matches his target intake exactly.
entries.note: Biennial. Miss autumn 2027 and the next intake is autumn 2029.

entries.label: RMC Copenhagen — Music Creation closes
entries.quote: RMC Copenhagen 3 February
entries.note: One of the earliest master's deadlines in the file. The record's own deadline field is a PRIOR CYCLE string (3 February 2026) and yields nothing; the report projects the same date for 2027.

entries.label: Detmold — Musikregie winter-semester window
entries.quote: Winter semester: 15 FEBRUARY – 15 MARCH. Summer semester: 1 OCTOBER – 1 NOVEMBER. For a September/October 2027 start: 15 Feb – 15 March 2027.
entries.note: Free and famous, and closed by a prerequisite degree — a 'Bachelor of Music Musikübertragung bzw. Diplom-Tonmeister' — plus German C1. The date is real; the door is not open.

entries.label: HSLU Lucerne — Music and Digital Creation closes
entries.quote: 28 FEBRUARY, verbatim: 'the deadline is 28 February (in a leap year on 29 February)'. This is a standing annual deadline, not a prior-cycle date, so 28 February 2027 for a September 2027 start.
entries.note: A published standing rule rather than a 2027 calendar entry. The one-page project description is due three weeks before the exam, which is later than the application deadline itself.

entries.label: HfMT Köln — Production (M.Mus.) non-EU deadline
entries.quote: the operative one for a Tunisian is the non-EU deadline of 2 March for winter-semester entry
entries.note: The best free option in the corpus: €0 tuition, German A2, two audio files plus working-method documentation, and a production test rather than an audition. The record's own deadline field says UNVERIFIED and the app renders 'NO CONFIRMED DATE'; the correction three paragraphs down names the date, and verdictWhy says to 'treat the 2 March non-EU deadline as the real date.'

entries.note: One of the two German programmes that genuinely gate on musicianship. The date is stable; the ear test is the barrier.

The record's own dates are 3 June (exam application) and 30 June (documents), marked indicative. The corpus is the source here; the spec's window is an open question.
